experience.event_idea: Pre-show Cava Baja Classics: set menu + jamón carving view 18:00–19:30 Wed–Fri
experience.event_why: Three consecutive evenings (Wed 21 flamenco, Thu 22 jazz/rock, Fri 23 sung dinner) bring ticket-holders within 0.7–1.2 km. A fixed-time, fixed-price set menu (huevos estrellados con jamón + rabo de toro or capón share + glass of D.O. wine, 28€) captures early diners before shows. The bar — already the 'best place to dine' for watching jamón carved (S11.47) — becomes the stage. Promote via Instagram story at 16:00 each day tagging the event venues. Monday–Tuesday switch to Comfort Pass (any main + wine 22€, 20:00–22:00) to build weekday regulars.
